senses.ex: According to unofficial reports, ten people were injured.
senses.exPt: Segundo informações não oficiais, dez pessoas ficaram feridas.

senses.def: to take things out of a bag, suitcase or box
senses.ex: I arrived late and didn't unpack until the next day.
senses.exPt: Cheguei tarde e só fui desfazer a mala no dia seguinte.

senses.def: not nice or enjoyable
senses.ex: There was an unpleasant smell in the kitchen.
senses.exPt: Tinha um cheiro desagradável na cozinha.

senses.def: to take a plug out of an electric socket
senses.ex: The heater is old, so unplug it when you go out.
senses.exPt: O aquecedor é velho, então tire da tomada quando sair.

senses.def: to stop using phones and computers for a while
senses.ex: On holiday I like to unplug completely for a week.
senses.exPt: Nas férias, gosto de me desconectar totalmente por uma semana.

senses.def: not liked by many people
senses.ex: The new tax is very unpopular with small businesses.
senses.exPt: O novo imposto é muito impopular entre as pequenas empresas.

senses.def: changing so often that you cannot know what will happen
senses.ex: The weather here is very unpredictable in spring.
senses.exPt: O tempo aqui é muito imprevisível na primavera.

senses.def: not based on what is possible or likely
senses.ex: Your plan is unrealistic; we don't have enough money.
senses.exPt: Seu plano é pouco realista; não temos dinheiro suficiente.

senses.def: not fair or sensible; asking for too much
senses.ex: The boss made unreasonable demands on his staff.
senses.exPt: O chefe fazia exigências absurdas aos funcionários.

senses.def: not connected to something else
senses.ex: He talked about something unrelated to the meeting.
senses.exPt: Ele falou de algo sem relação com a reunião.

senses.def: that you cannot trust or depend on
senses.ex: This old car is too unreliable for long trips.
senses.exPt: Este carro velho é pouco confiável para viagens longas.

senses.def: in a way that cannot be trusted to work well every time
senses.ex: The old printer works unreliably and often jams.
senses.exPt: A impressora velha funciona de forma irregular e vive travando.

senses.def: a situation in which people are angry and likely to protest or fight
senses.ex: Rising food prices led to social unrest in several cities.
senses.exPt: A alta no preço dos alimentos provocou agitação social em várias cidades.

senses.def: dangerous; likely to cause harm
senses.ex: It's unsafe to swim here when the sea is rough.
senses.exPt: É perigoso nadar aqui quando o mar está agitado.

senses.def: not good enough
senses.ex: The results of the test were unsatisfactory, so we did it again.
senses.exPt: Os resultados do teste foram insatisfatórios, então fizemos de novo.

senses.def: not harsh or severe, used about criticism
senses.ex: The review was surprisingly unscathing for such a bad film.
senses.exPt: A crítica foi surpreendentemente branda para um filme tão ruim.

senses.def: thinking about other people's needs more than your own
senses.ex: It was very unselfish of you to give up your seat.
senses.exPt: Foi muito generoso da sua parte ceder o seu lugar.

senses.def: to make someone feel worried or uncomfortable
senses.ex: The strange phone call unsettled her.
senses.exPt: O telefonema estranho a deixou inquieta.

senses.def: making you feel nervous, worried or uncomfortable
senses.ex: There was something unsettling about the way he stared at us.
senses.exPt: Havia algo perturbador no jeito como ele olhava para a gente.

senses.def: impossible to stop or defeat
senses.ex: The team seems unstoppable this season.
senses.exPt: O time parece imparável nesta temporada.

senses.def: not achieving what you wanted to achieve
senses.ex: Their attempt to climb the mountain was unsuccessful.
senses.exPt: A tentativa deles de escalar a montanha foi malsucedida.

senses.def: not right or acceptable for a particular person, purpose or situation
senses.ex: This film is unsuitable for young children.
senses.exPt: Este filme é impróprio para crianças pequenas.

senses.def: not certain about something
senses.ex: I'm still unsure about which course to take.
senses.exPt: Ainda estou em dúvida sobre qual curso fazer.

senses.def: not able to continue at the same level for long
senses.ex: The current level of public spending is unsustainable.
senses.exPt: O nível atual de gastos públicos é insustentável.

senses.def: in a way that harms the environment or cannot continue for long
senses.ex: Fish in this area have been caught unsustainably for decades.
senses.exPt: Os peixes desta região são pescados de forma insustentável há décadas.

senses.def: not having natural ability
senses.ex: Critics called him an untalented actor.
senses.exPt: Os críticos o chamaram de ator sem talento.

senses.def: to separate things that are twisted together
senses.ex: It took me ten minutes to untangle the Christmas lights.
senses.exPt: Levei dez minutos para desembolar as luzes de Natal.

senses.def: to understand or solve something complicated
senses.ex: Detectives are trying to untangle the mystery of her disappearance.
senses.exPt: Os detetives estão tentando desvendar o mistério do desaparecimento dela.

senses.def: no longer twisted together
senses.ex: Once the fishing line was untangled, he cast it again.
senses.exPt: Assim que a linha de pesca ficou desembaraçada, ele a lançou de novo.

senses.def: to a degree that is too extreme to imagine
senses.ex: The houses there are unthinkably expensive for young people.
senses.exPt: As casas lá são absurdamente caras para os jovens.

senses.def: not neat or organized
senses.ex: His bedroom is always untidy and full of clothes.
senses.exPt: O quarto dele está sempre bagunçado e cheio de roupa.

senses.def: to undo a knot or something that is tied
senses.ex: Can you help me untie this knot?
senses.exPt: Você pode me ajudar a desatar este nó?

senses.def: up to a particular time
senses.ex: The library is open until nine at night.
senses.exPt: A biblioteca fica aberta até as nove da noite.

senses.def: old-fashioned: to
senses.ex: The old king gave all his land unto his eldest son.
senses.exPt: O velho rei deu todas as suas terras para o filho mais velho.

senses.def: not given medical care, or not cleaned with chemicals
senses.ex: The infection can spread quickly if it is left untreated.
senses.exPt: A infecção pode se espalhar rapidamente se ficar sem tratamento.

senses.def: not cut to make it neat
senses.ex: His long, untrimmed beard made him look much older.
senses.exPt: A barba comprida e sem aparar o deixava bem mais velho.

senses.def: not usual; different from what normally happens
senses.ex: It's unusual to see snow here in April.
senses.exPt: É incomum ver neve aqui em abril.

senses.def: more than is normal or expected
senses.ex: It's unusually hot for October.
senses.exPt: Está fazendo um calor fora do comum para outubro.

senses.def: the quality of being different from what is normal
senses.ex: The unusualness of the design made the house famous.
senses.exPt: A singularidade do projeto deixou a casa famosa.

senses.def: not wanted
senses.ex: How can I stop getting unwanted emails?
senses.exPt: Como posso parar de receber e-mails indesejados?

senses.def: staying strong and not changing
senses.ex: Thank you for your unwavering support during this difficult time.
senses.exPt: Obrigado pelo seu apoio inabalável neste momento difícil.

senses.def: in a firm, steady way that does not change or weaken
senses.ex: She stared at him unwaveringly until he looked away.
senses.exPt: Ela o encarou sem vacilar até ele desviar o olhar.

senses.def: ill, not feeling healthy
senses.ex: I left work early because I felt unwell.
senses.exPt: Saí do trabalho mais cedo porque estava me sentindo mal.

senses.def: not wanting to do something
senses.ex: He was unwilling to help us with the move.
senses.exPt: Ele não estava disposto a nos ajudar com a mudança.

senses.def: not sensible; likely to cause problems
senses.ex: It would be unwise to invest all your money in one company.
senses.exPt: Seria imprudente investir todo o seu dinheiro em uma só empresa.

senses.def: not having much experience of life; naive
senses.ex: He was a shy, unworldly young man when he moved to the city.
senses.exPt: Ele era um jovem tímido e ingênuo quando se mudou para a cidade.

senses.def: towards a higher place on something
senses.ex: He ran up the stairs to his room.
senses.exPt: Ele subiu a escada correndo até o quarto.

senses.def: modern, or having the newest information
senses.ex: Make sure your phone's software is up-to-date.
senses.exPt: Verifique se o software do seu celular está atualizado.

senses.def: the way a child is cared for and taught how to behave
senses.ex: He had a very strict upbringing in a small village.
senses.exPt: Ele teve uma criação muito rígida num vilarejo pequeno.

senses.def: to make something more modern or add the newest information
senses.ex: I need to update the software on my laptop.
senses.exPt: Preciso atualizar o software do meu notebook.

senses.def: to give someone the latest news about something
senses.ex: Please keep me updated on the situation.
senses.exPt: Por favor, me mantenha informado sobre a situação.

senses.def: a newer version of something, or the latest news about it
senses.ex: There's a new update for this app.
senses.exPt: Tem uma atualização nova para esse aplicativo.

senses.def: to improve something or replace it with a newer, better version
senses.ex: You should upgrade to the latest version of the app.
senses.exPt: Você deveria atualizar para a versão mais recente do aplicativo.

senses.def: a change to something better, such as a better seat or room
senses.ex: The hotel gave us a free upgrade to a bigger room.
senses.exPt: O hotel nos deu um upgrade grátis para um quarto maior.

senses.def: a big change that causes a lot of confusion or worry
senses.ex: Moving to a new country was a huge upheaval for the children.
senses.exPt: Mudar para outro país foi uma enorme reviravolta para as crianças.

senses.def: feeling happier and more hopeful
senses.ex: I felt uplifted after talking to her.
senses.exPt: Eu me senti mais animado depois de conversar com ela.

senses.def: to move a file from your computer or phone to the internet
senses.ex: Can you upload the photos so everyone can see them?
senses.exPt: Você pode fazer upload das fotos para todo mundo ver?

senses.def: on; a more formal word for on
senses.ex: She placed the book upon the table.
senses.exPt: Ela colocou o livro sobre a mesa.

senses.def: higher than something else, or at the top
senses.ex: The bedrooms are on the upper floor.
senses.exPt: Os quartos ficam no andar de cima.

senses.def: standing straight up, not lying down
senses.ex: Keep the bottle upright so it doesn't leak.
senses.exPt: Deixe a garrafa em pé para não vazar.

senses.def: with your back straight
senses.ex: She sat upright in her chair when the boss came in.
senses.exPt: Ela se sentou reta na cadeira quando o chefe entrou.

senses.def: unhappy or worried because something bad happened
senses.ex: She was upset because nobody remembered her birthday.
senses.exPt: Ela ficou chateada porque ninguém lembrou do aniversário dela.

senses.def: with the top part at the bottom; also, in a very confused state
senses.ex: You're holding the map upside down!
senses.exPt: Você está segurando o mapa de cabeça para baixo!

senses.def: on or to a higher floor of a building
senses.ex: My bedroom is upstairs, next to the bathroom.
senses.exPt: Meu quarto fica lá em cima, ao lado do banheiro.

senses.def: towards a higher place
senses.ex: She looked upward at the stars in the sky.
senses.exPt: Ela olhou para cima, para as estrelas no céu.

senses.def: going towards a higher level or amount
senses.ex: House prices are showing an upward trend this year.
senses.exPt: Os preços dos imóveis estão numa tendência de alta este ano.

senses.def: relating to towns and cities
senses.ex: Traffic is a big problem in urban areas.
senses.exPt: O trânsito é um grande problema nas áreas urbanas.

senses.def: a strong sudden wish to do something
senses.ex: I felt a sudden urge to laugh in the meeting.
senses.exPt: Senti uma vontade repentina de rir na reunião.

senses.def: to strongly advise or try to persuade someone to do something
senses.ex: Doctors urge people to eat more fruit and vegetables.
senses.exPt: Os médicos insistem para que as pessoas comam mais frutas e verduras.

senses.def: needing attention immediately
senses.ex: I need to talk to you. It's urgent.
senses.exPt: Preciso falar com você. É urgente.

senses.def: in a way that needs to be dealt with immediately
senses.ex: We urgently need more volunteers for the event.
senses.exPt: Precisamos urgentemente de mais voluntários para o evento.

senses.def: the speaker and other people, as the object of a verb or after a preposition
senses.ex: Can you help us with these bags?
senses.exPt: Você pode nos ajudar com essas sacolas?

senses.def: the amount of something used, or the way it is used
senses.ex: Our water usage goes up in the summer.
senses.exPt: Nosso consumo de água aumenta no verão.

senses.def: to do something with a thing for a purpose
senses.ex: Can I use your phone for a minute?
senses.exPt: Posso usar o seu celular um minutinho?

senses.def: used to: did something regularly in the past but not now
senses.ex: I used to play football every day when I was a child.
senses.exPt: Eu costumava jogar futebol todo dia quando era criança.

senses.def: be used to: familiar with something so it is not strange or difficult
senses.ex: I'm not used to getting up so early.
senses.exPt: Não estou acostumado a acordar tão cedo.

senses.def: already owned or used by someone else
senses.ex: We bought a used car because new ones are too expensive.
senses.exPt: Compramos um carro usado porque os novos são caros demais.

senses.def: did something regularly in the past but not now
senses.ex: I used to play football every weekend.
senses.exPt: Eu costumava jogar futebol todo fim de semana.

senses.def: be used to: familiar with something, so it is not strange
senses.ex: I'm used to getting up early for work.
senses.exPt: Estou acostumado a acordar cedo para trabalhar.

senses.def: helping you to do or get something
senses.ex: This app is very useful for learning English.
senses.exPt: Este aplicativo é muito útil para aprender inglês.

senses.def: not useful; not working or not helping
senses.ex: This old phone charger is useless now.
senses.exPt: Este carregador de celular velho agora é inútil.

senses.def: a person who uses a product, service or computer
senses.ex: The app now has more than a million users.
senses.exPt: O aplicativo agora tem mais de um milhão de usuários.

senses.def: to show someone where to go by going with them
senses.ex: The waiter ushered us to a table by the window.
senses.exPt: O garçom nos conduziu até uma mesa perto da janela.

senses.def: usher in: to be the start of something new
senses.ex: The invention of the smartphone ushered in a new era of communication.
senses.exPt: A invenção do smartphone deu início a uma nova era da comunicação.

senses.def: the same as what normally happens
senses.ex: Let's meet at the usual place after work.
senses.exPt: Vamos nos encontrar no lugar de sempre depois do trabalho.

senses.def: in the way that happens most often
senses.ex: I usually get up at seven o'clock.
senses.exPt: Eu geralmente acordo às sete horas.

senses.def: a tool used in the kitchen or at home
senses.ex: Keep all your kitchen utensils in the top drawer.
senses.exPt: Guarde todos os utensílios de cozinha na gaveta de cima.

senses.def: a service such as water, gas or electricity provided to the public
senses.ex: The rent doesn't include utilities like water and electricity.
senses.exPt: O aluguel não inclui as contas de consumo, como água e luz.

senses.def: to use something for a practical purpose
senses.ex: We need to utilize our resources more effectively.
senses.exPt: Precisamos utilizar nossos recursos de forma mais eficiente.

senses.def: complete, used to make a negative word stronger
senses.ex: What he said was utter nonsense.
senses.exPt: O que ele disse foi um completo absurdo.

senses.def: to say something or make a sound with your voice
senses.ex: She didn't utter a single word during the meeting.
senses.exPt: Ela não disse uma única palavra durante a reunião.

senses.def: completely or extremely
senses.ex: I was utterly exhausted after the trip.
senses.exPt: Eu estava completamente exausto depois da viagem.
